name: Armor Kits for the Field
label: Quest
description: Armor Kits for the Field: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The brave volunteers of the Orgrimmar Legion have arrived to Silithus to aid us in our cause. Their supplies of armor kits were somehow lost in the trip. Obtain a batch of armor kits and deliver them to Merok Longstride at the location of the Orgrimmar Legion camp.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have something for me, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, yes... I will distribute these to the troops, friend. The Orgrimmar Legion thanks you!
